# robot-geographical-society — backend deployment

The campsite read API + availability collector run as a **single Cloudflare Worker** (`robot-geographical-society-backend`, Hono). It is reachable **only** through `https://api.robogeosociety.xyz`, fronted by **Cloudflare Access** — the `*.workers.dev` route is **disabled**, so there is no unauthenticated path. Account `d7adee58513c1b2f770ccaac90cf114f`.

```
  ┌────────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
  │  Browser (prod SPA)    │        │  Local Vite dev server        │
  │  (owner, SSO login)    │        │   /api same-origin proxy      │
  │                        │        │   attaches service token      │
  └───────────┬────────────┘        └───────────────┬──────────────┘
              │  owner SSO (email)                  │ rgs-local-dev
              │                                     │ service token
              ▼                                     ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Cloudflare Access  —  team silent-dew-44e3.cloudflareaccess.com   │
  │  app: api.robogeosociety.xyz   (2 policies: owner SSO + svc token) │
  │  ── workers.dev route DISABLED — no unauthenticated path ──        │
  └───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                                   │  (only authenticated path)
                                   ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Worker  robot-geographical-society-backend  (Hono)               │
  │                                                                    │
  │  Read API (behind Access)        Collector control                │
  │   GET /availability?date=          /collect/start|site            │
  │   GET /availability/:guid           /collect/dlq|reactivate       │
  │   GET /availability/:guid/site/:id  /scheduler/status  /watch     │
  │   GET /collectors                                                  │
  │                                                                    │
  │  CollectorLoop  —  durable self-scheduling Workflow                │
  │   refreshes each tracked site within MAX_STALENESS_DAYS = 2        │
  └───────┬───────────────────────┬──────────────────────┬───────────┘
          │                       │                      │
          ▼                       ▼                      ▼
  ┌───────────────┐      ┌──────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐
  │  R2           │      │  KV              │    │  Analytics Engine │
  │ campsite-raw  │      │  scheduler /     │    │  campsite_collector│
  │  raw/ summary/│      │  config state    │    │  campsite_avail-   │
  │  sites/ dlq/  │      │                  │    │  ability           │
  │  scheduler/   │      └──────────────────┘    └─────────┬────────┘
  │  heartbeat    │                                        │
  └──────┬────────┘                                        │
         │ summary/  (R2→Influx)                           │ AE SQL
         ▼  launchd daily 07:30                            ▼
  ┌──────────────────┐                          ┌────────────────────┐
  │  InfluxDB        │                          │  Grafana            │
  │  `campsites`     │ ───────────────────────▶ │  this dashboard +   │
  │  bucket          │                          │  Collector History  │
  └──────────────────┘                          └────────────────────┘

  Token vending:  Keychain bootstrap token ─▶ cloudflare-tfvend (Terraform)
                  ─▶ vends rgs-access-admin ─▶ robot-geographical-society/infra/access
                     (manages the Access app, 2 policies, rgs-local-dev service token).
                  wrangler (OAuth) handles Worker deploys + the custom-domain bind.
```

## Components

| Component | What it is | Reaches |
|---|---|---|
| **Frontend (prod)** | React/Vite SPA | Access via owner SSO → `api.robogeosociety.xyz` |
| **Local dev proxy** | Vite same-origin `/api` proxy; attaches the `rgs-local-dev` Access **service token** server-side (never in the browser bundle) | Access via service token |
| **Cloudflare Access** | Zero-trust front door, team `silent-dew-44e3.cloudflareaccess.com`; 2 policies (owner email SSO + `rgs-local-dev` service token) | Worker (the only authenticated path) |
| **Worker** | `robot-geographical-society-backend` (Hono): read API + `CollectorLoop` Workflow | R2, KV, Analytics Engine |
| **CollectorLoop** | Durable self-scheduling Cloudflare Workflow; refreshes each tracked site within `MAX_STALENESS_DAYS = 2` | writes R2 + AE |
| **R2 `campsite-raw`** | `raw/`, `summary/`, `sites/`, `dlq/<id>.json`, `scheduler/heartbeat.json` | read by the Mac-side ingest |
| **Analytics Engine** | `campsite_collector` (run rows) + `campsite_availability` | queried by Grafana over the AE SQL API |
| **InfluxDB `campsites`** | Mac-side launchd job ingests R2 `summary/` → Influx daily 07:30 | read by Grafana |
| **cloudflare-tfvend** | Terraform: Keychain bootstrap token → vends long-lived `rgs-access-admin` | `infra/access` |
| **infra/access** | Terraform manages the Access app, policies, and `rgs-local-dev` service token | — |
| **wrangler (OAuth)** | Worker deploys + custom-domain bind | — |

_Read endpoints + collector control all sit behind Access. The metric panels below read the same Analytics Engine + R2 storage signals the Worker emits; the daily Influx `campsites` bucket is the long-term history copy of R2 `summary/`._

panels.title: Latest collection
panels.description: Collector heartbeat from Analytics Engine: most recent collection time, ok/failed counts in the last 24h, and distinct sites collected in the last 2 days (the MAX_STALENESS_DAYS = 2 SLA window). Reads `campsite_collector`.

targets.query: SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_collection, SUMIf(_sample_interval, blob5='ok' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' DAY) AS ok_24h, SUMIf(_sample_interval, blob5='failed' AND timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1' DAY) AS failed_24h FROM campsite_collector WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '7' DAY
SELECT count(DISTINCT index1) AS sites_2d FROM campsite_collector WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND blob5 = 'ok'

panels.title: R2 stored (bytes)
panels.description: Bytes stored in the R2 `campsite-raw` bucket (raw/ + summary/ + sites/ + dlq/), from the Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API (`r2StorageAdaptiveGroups`). This is what the CollectorLoop banks.

panels.title: R2 objects (records)
panels.description: Object count in the R2 `campsite-raw` bucket, from the Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API (`r2StorageAdaptiveGroups`).

panels.title: Collection rate (collections / hour)
panels.description: Successful collections per hour from the CollectorLoop Workflow, summing sampling weights over `campsite_collector` where blob5='ok'. Follows the time picker.

targets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS t, SUM(_sample_interval) AS collections FROM campsite_collector WHERE $timeFilter AND blob5 = 'ok' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
